_generated: from admin.polyhaven.com/utils/assetCategories.ts (dimensionSchema) via scripts/generateSharedConstants.mjs - do not edit by hand

time_of_day.description: Time of day the DAYLIGHT indicates. Null whenever no daylight reaches the capture - a windowless room and a lamp-lit studio have no time of day however bright they look, and darkness from switched-off lights is not "night".

weather.description: Condition of the sky, judged from the sky itself or from the daylight it casts. Null whenever you cannot actually see it - any interior no daylight reaches, including every artificially lit studio. Do not answer "clear" for the absence of weather.

environment.description: Where the capture was made. Studio shots are indoor - the Studio category carries that distinction.

sky_view.description: How much open sky is visible. Null indoors, where it does not apply.

pure_sky.description: Edited pure-sky variant (ground removed), inheriting its base capture path.

surface_use.description: Where the material is typically applied.

origin.description: Manufactured, built or worked, versus naturally occurring.

setting.description: Where the material is typically found. Use "either" for materials equally at home in both, null if genuinely unassessed.

condition.description: Condition tags. Use "clean" when the surface shows no wear, dirt or damage; omit the key only if you genuinely cannot judge it.

aerial.description: Captured from the air by drone, so at a far larger scale than a ground scan.

material.description: All materials making up the object, most prominent first (multi-value, avoid a single "mixed"). Use "plant" for living or dried plant matter - foliage, grass, flowers, soft stems; "wood" is for timber and bark.

condition.description: Condition tags, same vocabulary and shape as the texture field. Use "clean" when the object shows no wear, dirt or damage; omit the key only if you genuinely cannot judge it.
